criterion: one observable behavior stated as a single yes/no test
applicability: when the criterion should be evaluated; otherwise it is not applicable

source.locator: section and local line or PDF page

operationalization.pass_if: trajectory evidence that satisfies the criterion
operationalization.fail_if: trajectory evidence that violates the criterion
operationalization.not_applicable_if: condition under which the item is omitted from the denominator
operationalization.evidence_to_quote: the exact trajectory span the grader should cite
